description: Defines thread-safe queue classes (QueueType and CategoryQueueType) with support for different priority categories, synchronization, and queue management functions.

classes.name: QueueType
classes.description: A template class implementing a thread-safe queue with watermarks, state management, and basic queue operations.

classes.name: CategoryQueueType
classes.description: A template class implementing a categorized, priority-based, thread-safe queue with dynamic threshold support.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes an entry from the queue if present.

methods.name: Post
methods.description: Adds an entry to the queue.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Attempts to insert an entry with optional waiting, considering queue state and thresholds.

methods.name: Extract
methods.description: Retrieves an entry from the queue, waiting if necessary.

methods.name: Disable
methods.description: Disables the queue, preventing further operations.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Clears all entries from the queue.

methods.name: HasEntry
methods.description: Checks if an entry exists in the queue.

methods.name: Visit
methods.description: Applies a provided action to each entry in the queue.

methods.name: Completion
methods.description: Marks a queued entry as completed and manages queue state accordingly.
